method.timing: median of five wall-time samples, 100000 calls after 10000 warmups per case; concurrent machine load; exploratory, not release qualification
method.heap: 20 interpreters; two forced full GCs before each heap measurement
method.source_note: A post-measurement thunk type assertion was widened to unknown; emitted JavaScript is unchanged.

decisions.closure: Retain: full library preserves validation, callbacks, hooks, lazy order, error attribution, and tracing; main runtime benchmark qualifies before/after behavior.
decisions.compact: Reject: eager-only prototype lacks validation, application errors, lazy control flow, hooks, and traces. Its 50.6 ns versus validated closure 53.6 ns does not demonstrate an end-to-end win and varied from an earlier 86.5 ns.
decisions.fold: Reject: numeric built-in whitelist prototype speeds a constant-heavy expression, but removes explain steps; arbitrary callbacks cannot be assumed pure or run during compilation.
decisions.source_cache: Retain a single most recent successful direct-call source of at most 1024 characters. Raw/fragment/checked/explain APIs retain their explicit prepared-runner semantics without this cache. Repeated calls improve 20x; unique/cycling misses cost 2.7/3.5 percent in this sample. Reject 64-entry Map due to larger miss costs.
decisions.lazy_thunks: Retain one memo closure per lazy operand; no extra read closure. Deferred reads remain memoized and reentrant; trace collection remains invocation-local.
